$meta.purpose: Demo fare inventory captured from Galileo/Travelport cryptic Fare Shop (FS) screens. Intended as a static corpus Ava can search during a demo when live GDS is unavailable.
$meta.taxHandling: All totals are TAX INCLUDED, as shown by the terminal.
notes: `codeshare: true` marks segments the terminal rendered with '@' — marketed by one carrier, operated by another.
`arrivesNextDay: true` is the terminal's '#' flag on a segment.
`dayOffset` is the itinerary-level '+1'/'+2'/'+3' badge: days between first departure and final arrival.
`aircraft` is the IATA equipment code the terminal printed before the fare basis — it is NOT a flight number.
Times are local to each airport, 24h, as displayed.
Prices are real captures; they are historical and not bookable.
`durationMinutes` and `layoverMinutesAfter` are computed from captured local times plus per-airport UTC offsets (Oct–Dec 2026), so overnight and multi-day sectors are correct.
`angle`, `score`, `savingsPct`, `badges` and `reasons` are derived by comparing each search set — they are demo-grade, not supplier-supplied.
`baggageKg`, `refundable`, `cabin` and `seatsRemaining` are representative values inferred from the RBD and carrier, not captured from the terminal.

adjustments: search 'lhe-bos-rt-14oct': the terminal showed return dates of 15–16 SEP against a 14 OCT outbound — a month BEFORE departure. Returns have been shifted to 28–29 OCT 2026 to make a coherent ~2-week round trip for demo use. Original values preserved per-itinerary in `_sourceReturnDates`.
Screens were truncated mid-list; only fully visible pricing options were transcribed. `totalOptionsReported` records what the terminal header claimed.
